"""Independent R7 integration probes; no model, network, real original or config."""
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT / "src"), str(ROOT / "tests"), str(ROOT)]

from company_wiki.automation.models import canonical_json
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_contracts import NarrativeBundle, NarrativeSelectResult, NarrativeContractError
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_verify import NarrativeVerifyHandler
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_transport import _bound_bundle
from company_wiki.automation.narrative_transport_contracts import NarrativeRef, NarrativeTransportError
from company_wiki.automation import narrative_generation as generation
from company_wiki._bounded_process import run_bounded, ChildFailed, ChildTimeout, OutputLimitExceeded
from company_wiki._process_tree import pid_is_alive
from company_wiki.source_catalog.official_source_flow import _validate_capture_receipt, OfficialSourceError
from tools.document_understanding_benchmark import phase_c_observer as observer
from tools.holdout_replay import producer
from support.narrative_model_request_fixture import selection
from unit.test_narrative_reading_transport import reading_context, summary


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def no_network(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED", "1")
    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError("independent probes forbid network")
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect", fail)
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "create_connection", fail)


def nested(value):
    for _ in range(100):
        value = {"child": value}
    return value


def test_full_large_bundle_survives_100_layers_without_losing_source_contract():
    base = selection(3)
    wire = base.to_dict()
    wire["reading_context"] = reading_context(base)
    diagnostic = nested("业务资料" * 120_000)
    wire["reading_context"]["layout_coverage"]["observed_details"] = diagnostic
    selected = NarrativeSelectResult.from_dict(wire)
    assert selected.to_dict() == wire
    bundle = NarrativeVerifyHandler._bundle(selected, summary(selected), selected.prompt_review)
    body = canonical_json(bundle.to_dict()).encode()
    assert len(body) > 1_300_000
    ref = NarrativeRef.from_dict({"schema_version": "narrative-ref/1", "artifact_version_id": "independent-large",
        "artifact_sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(), "byte_size": len(body),
        "source_ref": selected.source_ref.to_dict()})
    version = SimpleNamespace(content_sha256=ref.artifact_sha256, byte_size=len(body),
        selection_status=bundle.selection.status, quality_status=bundle.quality_status)
    read = _bound_bundle(version, body, ref)
    assert read.to_dict() == bundle.to_dict()
    assert read.to_dict()["reading_context"]["layout_coverage"]["observed_details"] == diagnostic
    assert read.to_dict()["evidence_spans"] == base.to_dict()["evidence_spans"]
    missing = bundle.to_dict()
    missing.pop("selection")
    with pytest.raises(NarrativeContractError):
        NarrativeBundle.from_dict(missing)
    altered = bytearray(body)
    altered[-1] ^= 1
    with pytest.raises(NarrativeTransportError, match="artifact_reference_mismatch"):
        _bound_bundle(version, bytes(altered), ref)


def test_large_capture_receipt_100_layers_does_not_replace_resource_or_identity_truth():
    receipt = {"content_sha256": "a" * 64, "response_bytes": 123,
        "capture_method": "synthetic_read", "tool_name": "independent_review",
        "tool_call_id": "local-only", "captured_at": "2026-11-02T00:00:00Z",
        "large_observation": nested("observed" * 60_000),
        "acquisition_usage": {"schema_version": "1.0", "response_bytes": 123, "cost_usd": "0"}}
    before = deepcopy(receipt)
    _validate_capture_receipt(receipt, sha="a" * 64, byte_size=123)
    assert receipt == before
    for change in ["source", "bytes", "cost"]:
        bad = deepcopy(receipt)
        if change == "source": bad["content_sha256"] = "b" * 64
        elif change == "bytes": bad["response_bytes"] = 124
        else: bad["acquisition_usage"]["cost_usd"] = "NaN"
        with pytest.raises(OfficialSourceError):
            _validate_capture_receipt(bad, sha="a" * 64, byte_size=123)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("damage", ["metadata", "derived-read"])
def test_auto_cache_tries_good_next_without_relaxing_explicit_invalid_pin(monkeypatch, damage):
    from unit.test_shared_reading_cache_precheck import _base, _final, _version
    good = _version(_final(dependencies=False))
    bad = SimpleNamespace(**good.__dict__)
    bad.artifact_version_id = "independent-bad"
    if damage == "metadata": bad.metadata_json = "not-json"
    class Store:
        def visible_base_generation_candidates(self, **kwargs): return (bad, good)
    calls = []
    def explicit_read(*args, **kwargs):
        pin = args[3]
        calls.append(pin["artifact_version_id"])
        if pin["artifact_version_id"] == bad.artifact_version_id:
            raise NarrativeTransportError("unavailable", "narrative_artifact_corrupt")
        return True
    monkeypatch.setattr(generation.ReadingReuseVerifier, "matches", lambda *_: True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(generation, "read_reuse_pin", explicit_read)
    payload = SimpleNamespace(subject=SimpleNamespace(kind="raw"))
    result = generation.find_reuse_pin(Store(), None, payload, _base(), {})
    assert result["artifact_version_id"] == good.artifact_version_id
    assert calls == ([good.artifact_version_id] if damage == "metadata" else [bad.artifact_version_id, good.artifact_version_id])
    with pytest.raises(NarrativeTransportError, match="narrative_artifact_corrupt"):
        generation.read_reuse_pin(None, None, payload, {"artifact_version_id": bad.artifact_version_id}, {})


def test_cache_discovery_preserves_source_budget_and_io_failures():
    failures = [NarrativeTransportError("blocked", reason) for reason in
                ("source_not_current", "source_after_as_of", "content_sha256_mismatch")]
    failures += [ValueError("MODEL_BUDGET_RESERVATION_UNKNOWN"), OSError("unavailable source store")]
    for error in failures:
        calls = []
        def read():
            calls.append(1)
            raise error
        with pytest.raises(type(error)) as caught:
            generation.discovered_cache_read(read)
        assert caught.value is error and calls == [1]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", ["capture", "event"])
def test_actual_prepare_is_not_retried_or_claimed_observed_after_callback_failure(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, failure):
    from unit.test_phase_c_read_capture import prepared_materials
    catalog, store, draft, config = prepared_materials(tmp_path)
    config["events"] = str(tmp_path / "missing-parent" / "events.jsonl")
    calls = []
    original = type(store).prepare
    def real_owner(*args):
        calls.append(1)
        return original(*args)
    if failure == "capture":
        def broken(*args): raise PermissionError("synthetic observation failure")
        monkeypatch.setattr(observer, "capture_prepared_checkpoint", broken)
    try:
        result = observer.prepared_artifact_observer(real_owner, config)(store, draft, b'{"actual":"owner bytes"}')
        assert result.status == "prepared" and calls == [1]
        error = config["observer_errors"][0]
        assert error["owner_artifact_version_id"] == result.artifact_version_id
        assert error["event_saved"] is False and error["activation_proven"] is False
        assert error["observation_status"] == "incomplete"
        assert error["checkpoint"] is None if failure == "capture" else error["checkpoint"]["stage"] == "prepared_not_activation_proof"
        assert json.loads(capsys.readouterr().err)["event_saved"] is False
        assert not Path(config["events"]).exists()
    finally:
        # CatalogStore has no persistent connection/close API.
        pass


@pytest.mark.parametrize("exit_code", [0, 23])
def test_noisy_both_streams_keep_actual_exit(exit_code):
    code = "import sys;sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'x'*150000+b'OUT_END');sys.stdout.flush();sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'y'*150000+b'ERR_END');sys.stderr.flush();sys.exit("+str(exit_code)+")"
    args = [sys.executable, "-B", "-c", code]
    kwargs = {"timeout_seconds": 10, "stdout_cap_bytes": 128, "stderr_cap_bytes": 128, "log_tail": True}
    if exit_code:
        with pytest.raises(ChildFailed) as caught:
            run_bounded(args, **kwargs)
        assert caught.value.returncode == exit_code
        assert caught.value.stdout.endswith(b"OUT_END") and caught.value.stderr.endswith(b"ERR_END")
    else:
        result = run_bounded(args, **kwargs)
        assert result["returncode"] == 0
        assert result["stdout_bytes_read"] == 150007 and result["stderr_bytes_read"] == 150007
        assert result["stdout"] == b'x'*121+b'OUT_END' and result["stderr"] == b'y'*121+b'ERR_END'


def test_noisy_timeout_still_reaps_the_actual_child(tmp_path):
    pidfile = tmp_path / "child.pid"
    code = "import pathlib,os,sys,time;pathlib.Path("+repr(str(pidfile))+").write_text(str(os.getpid()));sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'x'*150000);sys.stdout.flush();time.sleep(30)"
    with pytest.raises(ChildTimeout):
        run_bounded([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", code], timeout_seconds=0.6,
                    stdout_cap_bytes=128, stderr_cap_bytes=128, log_tail=True)
    assert pidfile.exists()
    assert not pid_is_alive(int(pidfile.read_text()))


def test_default_payload_receiver_still_enforces_its_real_configured_cap():
    with pytest.raises(OutputLimitExceeded):
        run_bounded([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", "import sys;sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'x'*70000);sys.stderr.flush()"], timeout_seconds=10)


def test_actual_dirty_producer_is_usable_but_wrong_runtime_is_not():
    head = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, check=True,
                          capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    observed = producer.verify_producer(ROOT, head)
    assert observed["producer_commit"] == head and observed["worktree_changes"]
    roots = producer.record_import_roots(ROOT)
    producer.assert_imports_from_producer(roots, ROOT)
    with pytest.raises(producer.ProducerError):
        producer.assert_imports_from_producer({**roots, "company_wiki": str(ROOT.parent / "foreign" / "__init__.py")}, ROOT)
    with pytest.raises(producer.ProducerError):
        producer.verify_producer(ROOT, "0" * 40)


def test_optional_git_diagnostics_failure_stays_unknown_not_permission(monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    def git(root, *args):
        calls.append(args)
        if args == ("rev-parse", "HEAD"): return "a" * 40
        raise producer.ProducerError("optional diagnostics unavailable")
    monkeypatch.setattr(producer, "_git", git)
    observed = producer.verify_producer(ROOT, "a" * 40)
    assert observed["worktree_changes"] is None and observed["branch"] is None
    assert len([row for row in calls if row[0] == "status"]) == 1

def test_optional_git_diagnostics_failure_stays_unknown_not_permission(monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    def git(root, *args):
        calls.append(args)
        if args == ("rev-parse", "HEAD"): return "a" * 40
        raise producer.ProducerError("optional diagnostics unavailable")
    monkeypatch.setattr(producer, "_git", git)
    observed = producer.verify_producer(ROOT, "a" * 40)
    assert observed["worktree_changes"] is None and observed["branch"] is None
    assert len([row for row in calls if row[0] == "status"]) == 1

"""Independent final R7 core delta probes, no author-source writes."""
from collections.abc import Sequence

sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT / "src"), str(ROOT / "tests"), str(ROOT)]
from company_wiki.document_understanding import statement_grammar as grammar
from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_evidence import select_narrative_evidence

from company_wiki.document_understanding.geometry_intent import reading, plan_geometry_requests, new_admission_state, admit_geometry_request
from company_wiki.document_understanding.geometry_intent.contracts import DiagnosticSink
from unit.du11_reading_plan.test_reading import routed, prepare
from unit.du11_production.test_source_information_binding import session_for, unit_id

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def no_network(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED", "1")
    def fail(*args, **kwargs): raise AssertionError("independent probes forbid network")
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect", fail)
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "create_connection", fail)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("first", [True, False])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("known", [
    "本公司已向客户交付新设备，尚未完成量产认证。",
    "如果监管许可获批，本公司供应商将交付设备。",
])
def test_local_unknown_clause_cannot_erase_or_upgrade_independent_source(known, first):
    unknown = "We aim to reopen northern service centres."
    text = known + " " + unknown if first else unknown + " " + known
    with patch.object(grammar, "_english_tagger", side_effect=LookupError("synthetic unavailable local POS")):
        baseline, _ = session_for([known])
        mixed, _ = session_for([text])
        def labels(session):
            return [(row["activity"], row["attribution"], row["modality"], row["polarity"], row["stage"])
                    for row in session.relations(unit_id(0))["relations"]]
        assert labels(mixed) == labels(baseline)
        assert sum(mixed.engine.relation_bindings(unit_id(0))) == sum(baseline.engine.relation_bindings(unit_id(0)))
        result = select_narrative_evidence(_document(_unit(text, kind="html_paragraph")),
            title="Annual report", existing_kind="annual_report", selector_version="0.9.0")
        unknown_only = select_narrative_evidence(_document(_unit(unknown, kind="html_paragraph")),
            title="Annual report", existing_kind="annual_report", selector_version="0.9.0")
    assert result.reading_context["source_processing_complete"] is False
    assert result.status == "partial"
    assert all(span.raw_text == text for span in result.evidence_spans)
    if known.startswith("本公司已"):
        assert {span.raw_text for span in result.evidence_spans} == {text}
    assert not unknown_only.evidence_spans
    assert unknown_only.reading_context["source_processing_complete"] is False


def test_real_combined_source_owner_reads_and_observes_once_but_changed_bytes_still_fail(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from contract.test_source_export_v2 import _fixture, TITLE
    from company_wiki.source_catalog import source_reader as reader_module
    from company_wiki.automation.narrative_source_guard import open_verified_source
    from company_wiki.automation.narrative_contracts import SourceRevisionEventPayload
    from company_wiki.source_catalog.source_reader import SourceReadError, SourceVersionReader
    from unit.test_narrative_select_handler import _payload
    catalog, _, original, ref, _ = _fixture(tmp_path, text_mode=True)
    reader = SourceVersionReader(catalog)
    body = original.read_bytes()
    payload = _payload(body, title=TITLE, document_kind="annual_report", language="en", mime_type="text/plain")
    payload["source_ref"] = asdict(ref)
    payload["expected_read_policy_sha256"] = reader.read_policy_sha256(ref)
    request = SourceRevisionEventPayload.from_dict(payload)
    reads, metadata = [], []
    read_bytes, describe = reader_module._read_verified_bytes, reader._describe_version
    def counted_read(*args, **kwargs):
        reads.append(1)
        return read_bytes(*args, **kwargs)
    def counted_description(*args, **kwargs):
        metadata.append(1)
        return describe(*args, **kwargs)
    monkeypatch.setattr(reader_module, "_read_verified_bytes", counted_read)
    monkeypatch.setattr(reader, "_describe_version", counted_description)
    monkeypatch.setattr(reader, "open_version", lambda *_a, **_k: pytest.fail("upper owner reopened source"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(reader, "describe_version", lambda *_a, **_k: pytest.fail("upper owner re-queried metadata"))
    try:
        assert open_verified_source(reader, request).data == body
        assert reads == [1] and metadata == [1]
        original.write_bytes(b"x" * len(body))
        with pytest.raises(SourceReadError):
            open_verified_source(reader, request)
    finally:
        catalog.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["5001-rows", "70-levels", "long-title"])
def test_legal_native_structure_uses_actual_account_instead_of_representation_cap(kind):
    outline = ([[1, f"Title {n}", n+1] for n in range(5001)] if kind == "5001-rows" else
               [[n+1, f"Title {n}", n+1] for n in range(70)] if kind == "70-levels" else
               [[1, "完整业务标题" * 2000, 1]])
    budget = WorkBudget(1_000_000)
    rows, complete = reading._native_rows(outline, 6000, budget, DiagnosticSink())
    assert complete and len(rows) == len(outline)
    assert rows[0]["title"] == outline[0][1]
    assert budget.used >= len(rows) and not budget.exhausted


def test_more_than_64_actual_keys_reuse_one_account_and_do_not_double_spend_page():
    from unit.du9_geometry_planner.test_root_policy_interop import compiled_offering, rule, window
    policy = compiled_offering()
    windows = [window(f"independent-{n}", rule(policy, "business"), n+1, n+1) for n in range(80)]
    budget = WorkBudget(800_000)
    plan = plan_geometry_requests(policy, windows, page_count=120,
        limits={"max_pages": 120, "max_requests": 100}, work_budget=budget)
    assert plan["limits"] == {"max_pages": 120, "max_requests": 100}
    keys = [row["window_key"] for row in plan["allocations"]]
    assert len(keys) == 80
    before = budget.used
    event, state = admit_geometry_request(plan, new_admission_state(plan), page=1,
        window_keys=keys, tabular_evidence="observed_candidate", remaining=120, work_budget=budget)
    assert event["decision"] == "admitted" and event["window_keys"] == keys
    assert budget.used > before and state["spent"] == {"pages": 1, "requests": 1}
    again, repeated = admit_geometry_request(plan, state, page=1, window_keys=keys,
        tabular_evidence="observed_candidate", remaining=119, work_budget=budget)
    assert again["decision"] == "deduplicated" and repeated["spent"] == state["spent"]
    rejected, unchanged = admit_geometry_request(plan, state, page=2, window_keys=["unknown-key"],
        tabular_evidence="observed_candidate", remaining=119, work_budget=budget)
    assert rejected["decision"] == "rejected" and unchanged["spent"] == state["spent"]


def test_stop_after_completed_windows_preserves_prefix_and_honest_partial(routed, monkeypatch):
    budget = WorkBudget(100_000)
    actual = reading._charge_material
    stopped = []
    def stop(value, account):
        if isinstance(value, list) and value and isinstance(value[0], dict) and "window_key" in value[0]:
            stopped.append(deepcopy(value))
            account.max_work_units = account.used
        return actual(value, account)
    monkeypatch.setattr(reading, "_charge_material", stop)
    result = prepare([[1, "Business", 1], [1, "Projects", 20]], budget=budget,
                     limits={"max_pages": 100, "max_requests": 100})
    assert stopped and budget.exhausted and result["partial"]
    assert result["windows"] == stopped[0]
    assert result["plan"]["summary"]["partial"]
    for row in result["windows"]:
        assert row["window_key"] == reading.canonical_digest({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k != "window_key"})


def test_empty_work_account_never_traverses_or_copies_plan_material():
    from unit.du9_geometry_planner.test_root_policy_interop import compiled_offering
    touched = []
    class Windows(Sequence):

        def __getitem__(self, index):

    result = plan_geometry_requests(compiled_offering(), Windows(), page_count=100,

    assert not touched and result["summary"]["partial"] and result["allocations"] == []
    assert budget.used == 0 and budget.exhausted
    with pytest.raises(WorkBudgetExceeded):
        admit_geometry_request({}, {}, page=1, window_keys=["unknown"],
            tabular_evidence="observed_candidate", remaining=1, work_budget=budget)


def test_large_real_handler_execution_uses_public_saved_result_reader_and_binding():
    from company_wiki.automation.models import HandlerOutcome, canonical_json
    from company_wiki.automation.narrative_contracts import NarrativeContractError, NarrativeSelectResult
    from company_wiki.automation.narrative_model import NarrativeModelResponse
    from company_wiki.automation.narrative_summarize import NarrativeSummarizeHandler
    from company_wiki.automation.narrative_summary_execution import parse_summary_job_result
    from unit.test_narrative_extractive_runtime import selected, VERSION
    from unit.test_narrative_summarize_handler import _context
    source = selected(1)
    wire = source.to_dict()
    wire["reading_context"]["groups"] = [{"group_id": f"independent-{n}", "kind": "business_progress",
        "section_role": "business", "evidence_ids": [source.evidence_spans[0].span_id]} for n in range(430)]
    source = NarrativeSelectResult.from_dict(wire)
    class RankModel:
        def generate(self, request):
            return NarrativeModelResponse("offline", "configured", request.prompt_version, b'{"decisions":[]}')
    result = NarrativeSummarizeHandler(model=RankModel(),
        reading_model_projection=lambda _subject: VERSION)(_context(source))
    assert result.outcome is HandlerOutcome.SUCCEEDED
    payload = result.to_dict()["result"]
    assert len(canonical_json(payload["execution"]).encode()) > 32*1024
    assert len(payload["execution"]["tasks"]) == 430
    parsed = parse_summary_job_result(payload, selected=source)
    assert parsed.draft.claims
    bad = deepcopy(payload)
    bad["execution"]["tasks"][0]["task_binding_sha256"] = "0" * 64
    with pytest.raises(NarrativeContractError):
        parse_summary_job_result(bad, selected=source)
